api.responseOkMessage: Your demo request has been received. A member of our team will be in touch within one business day.
api.responseErrorMessage: We were unable to process your request at this time. Please try again or reach out to us directly at support.
validation: fullName: required, string, min 2 characters, max 100 characters
workEmail: required, must be a valid email format, reject common free-mail domains (gmail, yahoo, hotmail)
companyName: required, string, min 1 character, max 120 characters
jobTitle: required, string, min 2 characters, max 100 characters
message: optional, string, max 500 characters, sanitize HTML entities
Rate limit: max 3 submissions per IP per 15-minute window
Honeypot field: hidden 'website' field must be empty or request is silently discarded
All string inputs trimmed and stripped of leading/trailing whitespace before validation
api.storageApproach: Phase 1 (now): Structured JSON logging to stdout via console.log, fully compatible with Vercel serverless log drains. Each accepted submission is logged as a single JSON object with all fields, a generated requestId (UUIDv4), timestamp (ISO 8601), and source IP. Vercel log drains can forward these entries to Datadog, Logflare, or a similar observability platform for searchability. Phase 2 (future): Introduce a lightweight connector module (e.g., Supabase, PlanetScale, or Airtable) behind an adapter interface so the storage backend can be swapped without changing the route handler. The adapter contract: { save(record): Promise<void> }.

ui.successBody: Your request has been submitted successfully. Our team will review the details and reach out to you within one business day to schedule a time that works best.
ui.errorBody: We could not submit your request. Please check your connection and try again. If the issue persists, contact us directly and we will be happy to help.
ui.privacyNote: By submitting this form, you agree to our Privacy Policy. We will only use your information to respond to your request and will never share it with third parties.
